story.body: You praised a seam that was finer than the old one, and Edith waited you out until the debt was on the tables. Heminges set Lady Day as the latest day, not as coin. Kemp told her to be paid, and told the prince to keep his arms in his coat, and she did not laugh for him. She laughed when she saw the line. Nobody paid. You did not pretend the debt was yours.
